title: Gloo to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on September 9, 2026
summary: The latest press from Gloo: Gloo to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on September 9, 2026
body_markdown:
BOULDER, Colo.--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--[Gloo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fgloo.com%2F&esheet=54594873&newsitemid=20260826010373&lan=en-US&anchor=Gloo&index=1&md5=4acc5e8a5c91ec980593f097786c6896) (Nasdaq: GLOO), a leading technology platform serving the faith and flourishing ecosystem, today announced that the company will report financial results for the second quarter ended July 31, 2026, on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 after close of market. On that day, management will host a conference call and webcast at 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss the company’s business and financial results.


Event: Gloo Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026
Time: 5:00 p.m. ET


Access Details: Participants may access the conference call via webcast using this link:[Gloo Webcast Link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fnupvk6w6%2F&esheet=54594873&newsitemid=20260826010373&lan=en-US&anchor=Gloo+Webcast+Link&index=2&md5=2796bd8f24bf89451211598a924cb2f6) . The link will also be available on the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at[investors.gloo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.gloo.com%2F&esheet=54594873&newsitemid=20260826010373&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.gloo.com&index=3&md5=3f1d508c0b8fc0f1b4a4a973a70682bc) .
